requirements.Title: NGB Keyed Bottles with High Page Yield
requirements.Description: Develop new NGB keyed ink bottles supporting 6,000-page yield for Black and 6,000-page yield for CMY, with bottle size for CMY supporting >8,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Higher yield bottles reduce frequency of replacement and increase value for high-volume users in SMB/Enterprise segments.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires compatibility with new tank size and IDS system.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New NGB bottles are available, pass reliability tests, and achieve stated yield per ISO standards.

requirements.Title: Spill-Free Reliability for Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement spill-free reliability mechanisms for ink bottles during user replacement and handling.
requirements.Rationale: Minimizes mess and user frustration, improving customer satisfaction and reducing support costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Linked to bottle and tank interface design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: No ink spillage occurs during normal bottle replacement in 100 test cycles.

requirements.Title: NOA-F with Metal Foiled Labyrinth and Lid Label
requirements.Description: Integrate NOA-F (Non-Original Authentication Filter) with a metal-foiled labyrinth design and lid label for security and reliability.
requirements.Rationale: Enhances product security and maintains ink integrity, protecting HP’s profit pool from counterfeits.
requirements.Dependencies: NOA-F component supply and bottle design.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: NOA-F passes security validation and reliability testing as per HP standards.

requirements.Title: Support for Customer Replaceable PHA and NOA-F
requirements.Description: Design the printer to allow end users to replace the Printhead Assembly (PHA) and NOA-F components without requiring a service technician.
requirements.Rationale: Improves serviceability, reduces downtime, and lowers service costs for customers and HP.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, Service, R&D, Product Management
requirements.Dependencies: Requires modular hardware design and user instructions.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: End users can successfully replace PHA and NOA-F in under 10 minutes with <1% error rate in usability tests.

requirements.Title: Increased Warranty Page Life Goal to 80,000 Pages
requirements.Description: The printer must support a new warranty page life goal of 80,000 pages, up from previous models.
requirements.Rationale: Longer warranty life increases perceived value and reduces total cost of ownership for high-volume customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires durable components and reliability testing.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer passes 80,000-page accelerated life testing with no critical failures.

requirements.Title: Support for 25/20ppm Print Speed (PDL: 25/19ppm)
requirements.Description: Printer must achieve print speeds of 25 pages per minute (ppm) for standard and 20 ppm for color (PDL: 25/19ppm).
requirements.Rationale: Competitive print speeds are necessary to win over SMB and Enterprise customers and flank competitors.
requirements.Dependencies: Dependent on print engine, ink delivery, and firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer achieves stated speeds in ISO/IEC 24734 testing.

requirements.Title: Size Optimization with Increased Tank Size
requirements.Description: Optimize the printer size to accommodate a larger ink tank, ensuring minimal footprint increase and alignment with tray protrusion changes.
requirements.Rationale: Larger tank supports higher yield bottles and page life; size efficiency is critical for office and home environments.
requirements.Dependencies: Ink tank, chassis, and tray redesign.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Printer dimensions increase by no more than 10% while supporting larger tank and bottles.

requirements.Title: Input/Output Tray Redesign for Tank Protrusion
requirements.Description: Redesign input and output trays to align with the protrusion of the enlarged ink tank.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures paper handling reliability and ergonomic access despite tank size increase.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Trays function correctly and meet HP paper handling standards with new tank.

requirements.Title: EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel Compliance (PDL SKU)
requirements.Description: Ensure the product meets EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel environmental certification requirements for the PDL SKU.
requirements.Rationale: Environmental certifications are necessary for market access and corporate responsibility.
requirements.Dependencies: Design, materials, and firmware must comply with certification requirements.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Product achieves EPEAT3, LOT4, and Blue Angel certifications before launch.

requirements.Title: 4.3” CGD Display Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate a 4.3-inch Color Graphic Display (CGD) for enhanced user interface and control.
requirements.Rationale: Larger, color displays improve usability and perceived product value.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 4.3” CGD is functional, passes usability testing, and meets HP display standards.

requirements.Title: Service Station Aerosol Management
requirements.Description: Implement aerosol management in the service station to accommodate changes due to the larger ink tank.
requirements.Rationale: Prevents contamination and maintains print quality as tank size increases.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Aerosol containment passes HP internal environmental and reliability tests.

requirements.Title: Carriage Dynamic and Force Model Update
requirements.Description: Update the carriage dynamic and force model to account for new tube routing and increased weights from larger tanks and bottles.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures printhead accuracy, reliability, and longevity.
requirements.Dependencies: Tube, tank, and carriage design changes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Carriage operates within HP force and accuracy specifications under all load conditions.

requirements.Title: Paper Path Durability for Increased Page Life
requirements.Description: Enhance the paper path design to support the increased warranty page life of 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for reliability and meeting new warranty standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Paper path passes 80,000-page accelerated life testing without failure.

requirements.Title: Ink Maintenance as Serviceable Part Post-80k Life
requirements.Description: Design ink maintenance components as serviceable parts that can be replaced at service centers after 80,000 pages.
requirements.Rationale: Extends printer life and supports new warranty targets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Ink maintenance parts are replaceable at service centers and pass post-replacement reliability tests.

requirements.Title: New IDS Startup Algorithm and Air Management
requirements.Description: Develop a new Ink Delivery System (IDS) startup algorithm and air management system to support larger tanks and new bottle designs.
requirements.Rationale: Ensures reliable startup and prevents air-related print issues with new hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: New IDS algorithm successfully completes startup in >99% of test cycles, with no air lock failures.

requirements.Title: New PQ Goals and Depletion Metrics
requirements.Description: Establish new Print Quality (PQ) goals and ink depletion metrics to align with higher yield and warranty page life.
requirements.Rationale: Maintains HP print quality standards with new consumables and extended use.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PQ metrics are met over the full warranty life in standardized testing.

requirements.Title: Reuse of Marconi Hi PDL and Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, Raccoon PSU
requirements.Description: Leverage existing Marconi Hi PDL, Tux dASIC, Hannibal aASIC, and Raccoon PSU components in the new platform.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces development time and cost by reusing proven hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Components function as intended in system integration tests.

requirements.Title: Stingray Wi-Fi Module and Dune Firmware Integration
requirements.Description: Integrate Stingray Wi-Fi module and Dune firmware for connectivity and device management.
requirements.Rationale: Modern connectivity is essential for SMB/Enterprise and consumer markets.
requirements.Stakeholders: End Users, IT, R&D, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Wi-Fi and firmware features pass HP connectivity and security tests.

requirements.Title: Gauss4.xx Security Hardware and Firmware
requirements.Description: Implement Gauss4.xx security features in both hardware and firmware for enhanced device protection.
requirements.Rationale: Meets current security standards for enterprise and SMB customers, protecting HP’s ecosystem.
requirements.Stakeholders: Security, IT, Enterprise Customers, Product Management
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Device passes HP security certification and penetration testing.

requirements.Title: PaaS and SMB Solution Enablement
requirements.Description: Enable Printer-as-a-Service (PaaS) and SMB-specific solutions, including onboarding paths (Consumer/HPX, HP One, SMB Portal, ECP) and scan/management solutions (WJA, HPSM, JAM).
requirements.Rationale: Addresses business model evolution and SMB/Enterprise requirements for manageability and service.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PaaS and SMB solutions are available and tested with all onboarding paths and management tools.

requirements.Title: Business Model Support for Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise
requirements.Description: Support flexible business models targeting Consumer, SMB, and Enterprise segments.
requirements.Rationale: Expands addressable market and aligns with HP’s strategic intent.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Business model options are documented and enabled in product launch materials.

requirements.Title: Compliance with Schedule Constraints
requirements.Description: Adhere to the defined program schedule, with hardware and bottle checkpoints as per Q3’25-Q4’27 timeline.
requirements.Rationale: Time-to-market is critical for competitive positioning and revenue targets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: All checkpoints met on schedule with documented evidence.

requirements.Title: SuperAmp PHA Life at 65K Constraint
requirements.Description: Ensure SuperAmp Printhead Assembly (PHA) achieves a minimum life of 65,000 pages as a non-negotiable constraint.
requirements.Rationale: Critical for reliability and cost-of-ownership targets.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: SuperAmp PHA passes 65,000-page reliability testing with no critical failures.

requirements.Title: Warranty Life of 80,000 Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering 80,000 pages or 2 years, whichever comes first, for the new printer model.
requirements.Rationale: Aligns with new page life targets and market expectations.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are published and supported by product reliability data.

requirements.Title: Serviceability – Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Include a serviceable maintenance box for easier servicing and reduced downtime.
requirements.Rationale: Improves user experience and lowers service costs for HP and customers.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced or serviced in <10 minutes with <1% error rate in usability tests.
